leftEvidence.role: Firstborn words before the lodging place
leftEvidence.title: The return journey carries a firstborn warning

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Moses sets out with his wife and sons while the LORD prepares him to confront Pharaoh.
points.right: At a lodging place the LORD meets “him” and seeks his death; Zipporah circumcises her son and touches the foreskin to “his feet.”

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Israel is called the LORD’s son and firstborn; Pharaoh is warned that refusal will bring the death of his firstborn son.
points.right: Zipporah speaks of a bridegroom of blood, and the threat is released after her action and words.

payload.posture: The firstborn warning ends in verse 23, and the lethal lodging-place encounter begins in verse 24.

rightEvidence.title: Zipporah acts during a lethal encounter

payload.tension: Immediate placement is undeniable, while the narrator leaves the exact relationship unstated.
payload.title: The warning and the interruption
